title: Ada and the Bakery
author: Odile Crane
blurb: Emrys Sandoval, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
